purpose: Teach: 念願/恐い/只今/ナイフ/マナー/水曜日/金持ち/ウソ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、念願、絶対、の、絶対、お店、絶対、ついに、絶対、出来そうよ
lines.en: Sho — my shop dream is finally coming true.
lines.style: Warm, excited but controlled. Soft opening—she's sharing something fragile. Steady pace, genuine smile in the voice, reaching toward him with the news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お化け、絶対、恐い、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis — but I'm scared of ghosts.
lines.style: Quiet, understated deflection. Small child voice cutting through her excitement with something true. Matter-of-fact, no drama, just stating the worry under the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、只今、絶対、の挨拶、絶対、家族に、絶対、欠かさないわ、翔くん
lines.en: And you know I always say hello to the family the moment I walk through the door—every single day.
lines.style: Tender, grounded. Speaking a habit that matters. Slow and deliberate, the rhythm of something she does without thinking but means entirely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ナイフ、絶対、お手伝いで、絶対、使えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can help with the knives now.
lines.style: Small chest of pride. Quiet confidence, not boasting. He's announcing a capability he's worked to earn. Steady eye-level delivery, grown-up for a moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、マナー、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、褒めてあげるわ
lines.en: Your manners are wonderful, Sho. I'm so proud of you.
lines.style: Genuine praise, no sugar-coat. Warm approval that lands because it's specific. Slight lean forward, eye contact steady, voice lifting just enough to carry the weight of the compliment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、水曜日、絶対、ピアノの日、絶対、なんだ
lines.en: I have piano on Wednesdays, you know.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact announcement. Child explaining his schedule like it's important news. Slight matter-of-factness, not seeking approval, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、金持ち、絶対、じゃないけど、絶対、幸せよ、翔くん
lines.en: I'm not rich, Sho, but I'm happy. That's what matters.
lines.style: Reflective, looking inward then outward. Slow, thoughtful delivery. Not sad—honest. The kind of quiet certainty that comes from meaning what you're saying about your own life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ウソ、絶対、絶対、つかないよ、約束
lines.en: I promise I'll never lie to you.
lines.style: Serious, absolute. The cadence of a vow. Quiet but unmovable. He's meeting her eye, offering something true. No hesitation, no lightness—just a child keeping a promise he understands means something.
